title: novoStoic optStoic input
description: Finds overall stoichiometry converting a precursor to a target molecule. Identifiers are MetaNetX ids.

primary_precursor.description: MetaNetX identifier of the starting molecule.

target_molecule.description: MetaNetX identifier of the molecule to produce.

min_int_val.description: Lower bound on stoichiometric coefficients. Container default applies when omitted.

max_int_val.description: Upper bound on stoichiometric coefficients. Container default applies when omitted.
